Yes, can I claim a home office deduction if I work remotely?

If you're self-employed and use part of your home exclusively for work, you can usually claim a home office deduction. However, if you're an employee working remotely, you unfortunately can’t claim this deduction under current IRS rules.
Got it. I'm self-employed and work in a separate room. What do I need to calculate the deduction?

Perfect! You can use either the simplified method (based on square footage) or the actual expense method, which takes into account things like rent, utilities, and maintenance. Make sure you have measurements and receipts ready!
